name: Booth
author: Izumi
description: Modelled on the Miruro site: a near-black canvas with a violet accent and a top bar. Home opens on a wide featured banner with pill buttons and violet pill slide markers, then poster rows with a score badge and an arrow at each heading. The watch page keeps the player deliberately small, docked to the left, with a scrolling episode list beside it and the episode discussion under it; the series page splits info and a thumbnail episode rail with pill tabs. Phones get a floating icon-only bottom bar.
